answer: In PoA, EigenTrust reputation is multiplied by exponential temporal decay, with a fixed half-life that makes influence require sustained, verifiable honest service rather than a single burst of activity. A freshly spawned sybil has near-zero eigenvector centrality because it lacks trusted incoming endorsements; reciprocity among sybils cannot bootstrap meaningful mass, so a tide of aliases, a cipher-only identity, or an umber label still cannot cross consensus thresholds.
